key_points: Barclays upgraded Medtronic to Hold, a modestly positive rating change.
Medtronic set the final exchange ratio of 4.5939 for the MiniMed split-off, advancing the restructuring.
Institutional purchases by Worth Asset Management and Congress Asset Management indicate underlying demand.
Analysts suggest MDT may be ~24% undervalued after CPT code wins supporting growth.
Short-term stock shows mixed performance vs peers, but the split-off provides a clearer forward outlook.
